props.name: value
props.description: JSON text, controlled; used when `data` is not given.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: JSON text to start from when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the text typed in the Input view.

props.name: editable
props.description: Add an Input view for pasting or editing the JSON.

props.name: expandDepth
props.description: Levels open at first. 1 shows only the top-level keys.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Scroll the body past this height.

examples.title: editable · expandDepth 1
examples.code:
<JsonViewer
  editable
  expandDepth={1}
  defaultValue={JSON.stringify(
    {
      ok: true,
      items: [1, 2, 3],
      next: { cursor: "c_91", more: true },
    },
    null,
    2
  )}
  title="Paste JSON"
/>
